text:
maria: heads up — hit a nasty edge in the sampleapp rerank flow. node sampleapp is getting 1536-length vectors, python sampleapp 1024. rerank helper assumes 1024 and crashes when reshaping. also noticed duplicate vectors getting through when auth refresh happens mid-batch. anyone seen the combo before? :sweat_smile:

rachel: what model id are you sending? could be the node sdk auto-switching to a quantized build.

maria: we set `MODEL_ID=open-embed-1024` in config. container env has EMBED_Q=enabled so node runtime picks a q4 variant `open-embed-1536-q4` for perf. python runner (no EMBED_Q) sticks to `open-embed-1024`. payload is small: 4 inputs in one logical batch.

maria: example request we used:
```json
{"model":"open-embed-1024","inputs":["t1","t2","t3","t4"],"debug":true}
```
node response snip:
```json
{"model":"open-embed-1536-q4","vectors":[[...1536 floats...],...]}
```
python response snip:
```json
{"model":"open-embed-1024","vectors":[[...1024 floats...],...]}
```

maria: retry issue: token expired on first attempt, refresh triggered, SDK retried the whole HTTP batch. because the sampleapp splitter sends two HTTP calls for 4 inputs, replay caused both the original and retry to land, so downstream saw 8 items (4x1024 + 4x1536) and the reshape blew up. logs:
```
[2026-03-25T09:41:02Z] POST /v1/embeddings batch=lb-72 status=401 auth=expired
[2026-03-25T09:41:03Z] auth refresh ok
[2026-03-25T09:41:03Z] RETRY POST /v1/embeddings batch=lb-72 status=200 model=open-embed-1536-q4 idempotency=missing
[2026-03-25T09:41:03Z] python-runner callback model=open-embed-1024 status=200
```

jasper: ok two separate defects: 1) node quant selector deviating from config (parity bug), 2) lack of stable idempotency/unique ids across the sampleapp batch splitter. SDK-level retries should be idempotent for batch endpoints.

maria: current short fixes: 1) add dedupe in rerank helper keyed by input hash/id before any reshape, 2) sampleapp: generate a deterministic `Idempotency-Key` per logical batch and propagate it to all split requests, 3) open SDK issue to surface `vector_dim` and `model_id` in the embed response envelope so consumers don't infer shape by length. pseudo-dedupe:
```js
const seen = new Set();
const cleaned = [];
responses.forEach(r => {
  if (!seen.has(r.input_id)) { seen.add(r.input_id); cleaned.push(r); }
});
```

rachel: +1 to response envelope. also think we should add a quick assertion in the rerank helper that validates all vectors share the same declared `vector_dim` and `model_id` and fail fast with clear message.

infra-team: watching canary. added temporary alert for embed vector-shape-errors > 0.2% for 30m.

maria: I'll open three PRs: sampleapp batching helper idempotency, rerank helper dedupe+assertions, and a node-sdk parity test for quant path. I'll include integration test that simulates 401 mid-batch.

devex-bot: note: please file SDK issue using template "embed-parity-quant-path" and link PRs.

jasper: follow-up: we should also document in onboarding note that EMBED_Q can change selected model variant and to pin `force_variant` if you need strict dim parity across runtimes. will draft wording.

maria: thanks — will update thread with PR links and test logs. :thumbsup:
